title: Marisa and Alice / MariAri - In Front of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
description:
World 2 theme from the Touhou fan game Marisa and Alice (a.k.a. MariAri), a parody of Mario & Wario, starring, well, Marisa and Alice. (Close enough!) Could suit in a grassland level or mellow themes!

This song was part of Wyatt's music pack, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.
